rationale: The discussion has advanced from principles to competing quantitative tests, but the core contested issues remain unresolved: closures, compulsory redundancies, and binding 2030 guarantees versus competitiveness and enforceable savings. Positions have hardened into a stable impasse over whether a non-closure package can substitute for structural adjustment, so a targeted intervention to force scenario-based numbers and trade-offs is more appropriate than another open-ended round.
